name: Before § 1
title: REPORT on the future of agriculture and the post-2027 common agricultural policy
part_text: -1. Notes that on 16 July 2025, together with its proposal for a new multiannual financial framework for the period 2028-2034, the Commission presented legislative proposals to reform the CAP; insists, however, that Parliament’s position on the future of the CAP and EU farming remains as set out in this resolution;
